Job title-     Sr. SharePoint Consultant
 Duration-  Contract
 Location-  Denver, CO

  
 Description-
  
 A Sharepoint Designer Consultant assists our customers to improve graphic design and web page development.
 The Sharepoint Designer should have a firm grasp of HTML and .CSS and have demonstrated the ability to create designs and mockups using tools such as Adobe Photoshop or Fireworks. 
 Candidate must have experience working with SharePoint 2010 advanced features including page design; master page development, and workflow. 
 This role will entail a strong functional and technical understanding of SharePoint 2010.
